headline: Sunderland bottom and in trouble, yet Leeds only narrow favourites
summary: Sunderland have lost four in a row and are bottom of the Premier League. Kevin Danso was sent off 17 minutes into the Bournemouth defeat and is out for Leeds' visit, and Football Insider report that Regis Le Bris is under pressure. Leeds sit 7th with 10 points — yet away at the bottom side they are only 37.8% favourites across 10 bookmakers, with Sunderland at 32.0%. Leeds are rated only a tenth of a goal better, so the table gap almost disappears. The goals line is 2.25, with over at 51.5%.
read: Sunderland are bottom of the Premier League, four straight defeats behind them, a suspended centre-back and a manager under reported pressure — and they host a Leeds side seventh in the table and fresh from a draw with Manchester United. The market makes Leeds narrow favourites at 37.8% but rates the two teams almost level on the handicap, with a goal line just above two.

facts.fact: Sunderland lost 0-2 at Bournemouth on Sunday, a fourth straight Premier League defeat, and they are bottom of the table.
facts.meaning: The worst possible run-in for a home game against a top-seven side: one point from their last five league matches and no home win to lean on.

facts.fact: Sunderland will be without centre-back Kevin Danso, sent off 17 minutes into the Bournemouth defeat and now suspended for Leeds' visit.
facts.meaning: A starting centre-back missing means a reshuffled back line in front of a defence already shipping goals.

facts.fact: Football Insider report that Regis Le Bris is under pressure at Sunderland, with the board expecting more from him, though there is no immediate expectation he will be sacked.
facts.meaning: Adds scrutiny to a bottom-of-the-table side going into a home game — the mood around the club is as low as the league position.

facts.fact: Leeds sit seventh in the Premier League, having drawn with Manchester United at Elland Road on Sunday.
facts.meaning: A settled top-half side travelling with confidence, against the team bottom of the division — the gap in the table is the backbone of this match.

facts.fact: Leeds are the market's favourites at 37.8%, against Sunderland's 32.0%, with the draw at 30.1%.
facts.meaning: Away favouritism, but a narrow one — the market sees this as a close game between a side in form and a side at home.

facts.fact: Sunderland's win chance has slipped from 33.9% to 32.0% in recent days, with Leeds up from 35.9% to 37.8%.
facts.meaning: Money and information have drifted towards the away side, but only mildly — this is a nudge, not a stampede.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line sits at +0.11 goals from Sunderland's perspective — Leeds are rated only a fraction of a goal better.
The main goal line is 2.25, with Over priced at 51.5%.
facts.meaning: The market leans just over two goals — a game it expects to be open rather than cagey.

sources.fact: Football Insider report that Regis Le Bris is under pressure at Sunderland with the board expecting more from him, though there is no immediate expectation he will be sacked.
Sunderland suffered a fourth straight defeat and were beaten 2-0 at Bournemouth, who earned their first league win of the season against the 10-man Black Cats.
Sunderland will be without Kevin Danso for Leeds' visit after the centre back was sent off 17 minutes into the 2-0 defeat at Bournemouth.
Sunderland have an early injury update ahead of their Lech Poznan and Leeds United fixtures, with up to eight players potentially missing the Poznan trip.
Brian Brobbey trained ahead of Sunderland's Lech Poznan and Leeds United matches, and Kevin Danso also trained, according to OneFootball.
Sunderland supporter groups have called for a controversial derby 'bubble' decision to be reversed, with the club saying it was disappointed with the ruling.
Dan James could return for Leeds United at the Stadium of Light, with Daniel Farke facing potential triple injury news before the Sunderland clash.
Leeds drew 1-1 with Manchester United at Elland Road, Dominic Calvert-Lewin scoring their second-half equaliser.
